actions.name: Lighting state
actions.description: Preshow / Show / React / BRB / Outro (lights + screen video follow)

actions.name: Stage mode
actions.description: Talk, React, Gaming or any installed mode (interview, …)

actions.name: Go to room
actions.description: Switch the room (with the transition card). Empty = Classic (no room)

actions.name: Room area
actions.description: Next / previous area of rooms that have areas, or an area key

actions.name: Reveal room (curtain)
actions.description: Hold-mode transition card: reveal the new room now

actions.name: Hide my screen (capture cover)
actions.description: Animated card over your game / window capture (Blow the cartridge, Jacking in, Press Start …). Same as the Hide my screen key (Ctrl+B unless changed in Live → Privacy)

actions.name: Room transition
actions.description: The card that covers a room change: style, speed (seconds) and “wait for me” (hold until you reveal)

data.label: Style id (vtp-dark, vtp-light, shuffle, cut …; keep = no change)

actions.name: Camera move
actions.description: How the camera changes shots: 0 = a hard cut, else a glide of that many seconds

actions.name: BRB card look
actions.description: The Be Right Back card (BRB = the BRB lighting state: fade to black, guests muted, this card): animation, Light / Dark, its words

data.label: Your own background (none = remove; empty = no change)

actions.name: Hide chat on stream
actions.description: Hides the chat monitor, the chat buddy and the docked chat from viewers (support alerts stay)

actions.name: Screen video
actions.description: Play / stop / next on the room screen

actions.name: Scene camera
actions.description: Talk / React / Gaming …: close-up (of someone), group, wide, the screen (centres the video / react window) or a room camera

actions.name: In the room / outside
actions.description: Bring someone into the room or send them out (me, or a party member): walk through the door or appear instantly

actions.name: Entrances
actions.description: Walk-ins on / off (off = people appear in their seats), and how people who join arrive

actions.name: Screen video sound
actions.description: Toggle the screen video sound on the OBS page

actions.name: Ambient cameras
actions.description: Preshow / BRB / Outro camera moves: next shot, pick a move (orbit, pan, tour …), on / off

actions.name: Weather
actions.description: Rooms with time of day / weather

actions.name: Time of day
actions.description: Set the clock of rooms with time of day (0–24)

actions.name: Background raid
actions.description: Background combat on / off

actions.name: Warzone set piece
actions.description: Warzone rooms: call in an air strike, an armoured push, a militia assault the frogs repel, a technical, a mortar barrage, a gunship pass, flares or the sniper

actions.name: Calm the battle
actions.description: Warzone rooms: no new big moments and no shake inside while you talk (the far fighting goes on)

actions.name: Club moment
actions.description: Club room bits: conga, danceoff, raid, tip, big …

actions.name: Lounge celebration
actions.description: Hangout lounge: test a donation tier (bar drinks / shots, patio firepit + fireworks, lounge champagne + balloons), gifted subs, a gift train, or calm / off

actions.name: Slap!
actions.description: The minion slaps someone (random guest, host or a name)

actions.name: Emote
actions.description: Play a VRMA emote by name ("stop" stops it)

actions.name: Expression
actions.description: Show an expression for a few seconds

actions.name: Interview shot
actions.description: Interview mode camera: auto / manual director, host, co-host 1–2, hosts, panel, guest 1–4, two-shot, wide …

actions.name: Guest: studio / monitor
actions.description: Interview guest N (or a member id): seated in the studio or on the monitor

actions.name: Co-host / guest
actions.description: Interview: make someone a co-host (sits with you at the desk) or a guest again. Who: a member id, guest1…4 or cohost1…2

actions.name: Let in (knock)
actions.description: Let in the first person knocking

actions.name: Deny (knock)
actions.description: Turn away the first person knocking

actions.name: Kick guest
actions.description: Remove party member N (or a member id). "Also block them": they can’t come back with the same account / browser tab

data.label: Also turn the invite link off

actions.name: Mute guest
actions.description: Mute / unmute a guest everywhere: stream, the OBS page, your speakers and every other guest’s ears (party member N, or a member id). Undo-able

actions.name: Hide guest camera
actions.description: Hide / show a guest’s camera on stream, the OBS page and for other guests (everyone sees a “Camera off” card; a 3D-avatar guest leaves the room). Party member N or a member id

actions.name: Guest volume
actions.description: A guest’s volume on stream, in your speakers and in the other guests’ mix (0–100)

actions.name: Cut guest (camera + mic)
actions.description: Panic button for one guest: camera AND mic off at once, everywhere. Press again (toggle) or Undo brings them back

actions.name: Cut all guests
actions.description: Emergency: every guest’s camera and mic off at once (one Undo brings them all back)

actions.name: Undo (guest moderation)
actions.description: Undo the last camera / mic / volume / cut change

actions.name: Cut: also to green room
actions.description: When you cut a guest, also send them back to the green room (off the show until you bring them on)

actions.name: Link guests: voice
actions.description: Talk with link guests without Discord: hear them in the studio / send them your voice

data.label: Mic id (Pick the mic; empty = same as lip sync)

actions.name: End party
actions.description: Close the party for everyone

actions.name: Copy interview link
actions.description: Mint + copy a no-install guest link (in the studio window), or turn the current link off (it stops working for everyone)

actions.name: Bring on (green room)
actions.description: Bring a guest from the green room onto the show (the Entrances setting: walk in / appear). Empty = the next guest (READY first, then who waited longest)

actions.name: Back to green room
actions.description: Send a guest back to the green room (they walk out first when walk-ins are on). Empty = the guest brought on last

actions.name: Next guest
actions.description: The guest brought on last goes back to the green room and the next waiting guest (READY first) comes on

actions.name: Message a guest
actions.description: Send a guest a message on their page (no sound: a banner): up next, in 1 minute, you’re live, hang tight, or your own text

actions.name: Talk backstage
actions.description: Two-way voice with one waiting guest only (plays on the backstage output you picked, never on the OBS page)

actions.name: Backstage voice output
actions.description: Where backstage voice plays (headphones OBS does NOT capture). Empty = the default output

actions.name: Green room: who waits
actions.description: Who waits in the green room when they join: link guests (default), everyone, or nobody (straight in)

actions.name: Outfit
actions.description: Switch outfit by id (empty = default outfit)

actions.name: Accessory on / off
actions.description: Toggle an accessory by id

actions.name: 2D model slider / outfit
actions.description: Pro2D models: toggle, step, set or reset a model slider (chest, body, outfit, hair …) or switch an outfit on / off, by the name the studio shows (empty = the first slider)

actions.name: Recalibrate face
actions.description: Hold a neutral face for 2.5 s: re-centres the tracking

actions.name: When tracking is lost
actions.description: Hold last pose / return to rest / voice life when the camera loses you (per part, or all); "cycle" steps through them

actions.name: Acknowledge next
actions.description: Mark the oldest open support / event as done

actions.name: Thank next
actions.description: Thank the oldest open supporter

actions.name: Acknowledge all
actions.description: Clear the whole queue

actions.name: Skip read-aloud
actions.description: Stop the message being read out

actions.name: Replay read-aloud
actions.description: Read the last message again

actions.name: Read-aloud on / off
actions.description: Text-to-speech of donation messages

actions.name: Emote sounds on / off
actions.description: The sounds you gave emotes (Chat → Emotes): play when chat uses them

actions.name: Start poll
actions.description: Start a saved poll by name (empty = the last saved one, else Yes / No; "1–4" = the 1–4 preset)

actions.name: End poll
actions.description: End the running poll now (winner reveal)

actions.name: Show / hide poll
actions.description: Show or hide the poll card on stream

actions.name: Subathon timer
actions.description: Pause / resume the subathon, add or take off time, undo the last change, happy hour, sleep mode, or start a new one

data.label: Minutes (add / take off / happy hour length)

actions.name: Goal
actions.description: Show / hide a goal on stream, add to it by hand, or start a new stream (every-stream goals start over)

data.label: Goal (its name or number; empty = the first)

actions.name: Spin the wheel
actions.description: Spin the wheel on stream (its slots are set in Goals & subathon)

actions.name: Applause
actions.description: The whole chat audience claps and cheers

actions.name: Next question
actions.description: Show the next approved question (pinned first, then paid / bumped, then oldest)

actions.name: Question done
actions.description: Take the question being answered off stream

actions.name: Throw at my head
actions.description: Chat emotes, a starter prop or your own picture fly at the avatar's head (headpat = a hand pats it)

actions.name: Item scene
actions.description: Turn a saved set of stickers / props on the avatar on, off or toggle (empty name = the last one used)

actions.name: Sticker on me
actions.description: Put a sticker or item on the avatar (random from your sticker set when empty), or clear them

actions.name: Emote rain
actions.description: Chat emotes fall onto the avatar's head and shoulders

actions.name: Play a sound
actions.description: A soundboard sting. Plays on the OBS page only, and only when sounds are switched on

actions.name: Screen effect
actions.description: A short full-frame effect: glitch, VHS, pixelate, shake, bloom pop or black & white (always inside the flash-safety limit)

actions.name: My recorded emote
actions.description: Play an emote you recorded from your own camera (empty = the latest one)

actions.name: Co-host says
actions.description: The AI co-host says a line, or answers chat when empty (needs the co-host switched on)

actions.name: Mute co-host
actions.description: Stop the AI co-host from talking (and let it talk again)

actions.name: Custom command
actions.description: Any studio bus command (docs/SCENES.md): command name + JSON args
